The Reception Lounge glows with bright morning daylight across polished terrazzo flooring, featuring an emerald velvet bench, a coat rack, and a sleek walnut desk.

Clara warmly welcomes Chloe to discuss her hair makeover while Chloe nervously twists a strand of blonde hair.
